title: Map Assumptions and Resolve the Riskiest One First
service: RiskMap: explicit assumptions, pre-registration and evidence decisions
runtime: Python3.10+, standard library and pytest; no model/network

parts.lesson_anchor: Risk Is Not One Number; evidence supports bounded-build/rejects reframe-or-stop; highest open risk
planted_bugs: reject verdict producer becomes supported in caller build decision
next-experiment risk ties disagree with stable map
ranks count every other assumption pair
parts.overfix_guard: all statuses ranked, inconclusive open, input untouched; correct strict integer and risk formula helpers

parts.lesson_anchor: explicit assumptions, evidence and pre-registered experiment fields
parts.exactness: typed dataclasses, None versus empty receipt, float bits including negative zero, raw multiline Unicode/timestamps, saved order
traps: reopen typed rows and replace both tables

parts.lesson_anchor: Design an Experiment, Not a Confirmation Ritual
parts.algorithm: fixed first-N mean, strict pre-registration and explicit pass/fail/ambiguous actions
traps: only first N arrivals and uncertainty floor

parts.lesson_anchor: experiment observations become evidence and next decisions
parts.wire_format: logfmt with supplied JSON scalar quoting
traps: immediate completed outcome before future pull
partial/empty EOF output in declared order
closing after yield does not prefetch

parts.lesson_anchor: Every Build Contains Bets; conditions for build value/usability/feasibility/safety
traps: decided branches offer no next experiment
risk priority only among influential open leaves

deviations: Stable ids, explicit evidence verdicts and one-based ranks turn the lesson map into a deterministic local service. The source formula is supplied correct; strict-int and bool/float guards are not planted defects.

Pre-registration must precede the earliest used observation, with first-N arithmetic mean and uncertainty reduced by one after decisive evidence. These are exact exercise rules, not statistical or universal scoring claims.
CSV replaces the source JSON output. The raw input strings survive storage; the correct supplied instant parser converts Z to +00:00 for Python3.10.
Supplied SampleBook handles keyed first-N freezing and once-only completion; supplied logfmt serializer handles quoting. Candidate streaming work is emission/termination/EOF/cancellation.

Finite nonempty ALL/ANY is an exercise representation of composite build assumptions, not a claim the original lesson teaches a general logic engine. No natural-language falsifiability classifier or graph prerequisite algorithm is required.
